title: El error
goal: Own a mistake that cost money
culture: Say it before anybody looks around. He forgives the mistake and not the lie, and the whole ritual is four short sentences — own it, confirm it, fix it, promise once. Tomorrow nobody will mention it again.

beats.good: Immediately, before anybody starts looking around. Fue mío is two words and it is the difference between a mistake and a problem.
No explanation yet. He asked a yes-or-no question and the only thing that helps you is the yes.
Get to the fix as fast as you can. He is not interested in how you feel about it, and telling him would make it about you.

beats.es: Le va a costar a usted, ¿oyó?
beats.say: Está bien. No vuelve a pasar.
ok: esta bien no vuelve a pasar
beats.good: Take the cost without arguing and promise exactly once. That is the whole ritual, and tomorrow nobody mentions it again.
